plans.idea: Headline-led poster that rebuilds the original three-bottle lineup: logo, then a big stacked headline-and-flavour copy block, then the hero bottle and the two-bottle group side by side at the same height as one row of three, with the Build Your Pack button centred underneath.

Product-first story: the three-bottle lineup (hero plus the two-bottle group as one row) sits directly under the logo as the visual hook, then a tall full-width copy block lets the headline run large, and the button closes the read at the bottom.

Single-spotlight column: logo and headline copy on top, one large centred hero bottle as the focal point, the other two bottles as a small 'pack' row directly beneath it, then a wide button, all on one centre axis.
